benefits_health_001.evidence: Group health insurance is provided through TRS-ActiveCare, the statewide public school employee health insurance program. Employees eligible for health insurance coverage include the following: • Employees who are active, contributing TRS members • Employees who are not contributing TRS members and who are employed for 10 or more regularly scheduled hours per week.

benefits_health_contribution_002.evidence: The district’s contribution to the employee insurance premiums is determined annually by the board of trustees.

benefits_health_employee_premium_003.evidence: Detailed descriptions of insurance coverage, employee cost, and eligibility requirements are provided to all employees online at the Employee Benefits Center (EBC).

benefits_dependent_health_004.evidence: Current employees can make changes in their insurance coverage during open enrollment each year or when they experience a qualifying event (e.g., marriage, divorce, birth). Detailed descriptions of insurance coverage, employee cost, and eligibility requirements are provided to all employees online at the Employee Benefits Center (EBC).
